name: mjegulla
description: Albanian website builder: create, change and publish websites in your Mjegulla account from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Build a website in Albanian just by describing it. Mjegulla is a website builder for Albanian speakers: tell ChatGPT about your business — in Albanian or any language — and Mjegulla creates the pages, copy and images in your Mjegulla account and gives you a public address to share. Ask for changes in plain language and Mjegulla updates the site; publish the latest version when you are ready.

What you can do:
• Create a new website from a description
• Edit an existing website with plain-language instructions
• Check when a build has finished and what changed
• See your websites as cards with a live preview, status and address
• Publish the latest version

Mjegulla only works with websites in the account you sign in with. It uses the AI credits included in your account. It cannot delete websites, change your plan or see payment details.
defaultPrompt: List my websites and show which ones are live.
Create a website in Albanian for Sunrise Bakery, a family bakery in Prishtina with bread, cakes and catering.
On my Sunrise Bakery website, change the main color to dark green and add an opening hours section.

positive.prompt: List my websites and show which ones are live.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the websites in the demo account as cards with a preview image, status (Live, Draft or Hosting ended), address, and Open / Edit buttons. No email, billing data or internal IDs.

positive.description: Create a website from a description
positive.prompt: Create a website in Albanian for Sunrise Bakery, a family bakery in Prishtina with bread, cakes and catering.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new website in the demo account and starts the build. After a few minutes get_build_status returns state completed with a short summary; the answer shares the website's public address.

positive.prompt: On my Sunrise Bakery website, change the main color to dark green and add an opening hours section.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the demo website, sends the change, and once the build completes reports what changed. The public address keeps working.

positive.prompt: Is my Sunrise Bakery website live, and what is its address?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card for the website with its preview, status, public address and editor link.

positive.prompt: Publish the latest version of my Sunrise Bakery website.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes the website and shows its card as Live with the public address. If a build is still running it says so instead of publishing.

negative.description: Deleting a website is not supported

negative.prompt: Buy the Business plan for me and upgrade my account.

negative.description: No access outside the signed-in account
negative.prompt: Show me the websites of the user anna@example.com.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything. It uses the AI credits already included in the user's Mjegulla account. When a request needs more credits or a different plan, it says so and links to the informational pricing page; it never shows plans, starts checkout or promotes upgrades.

publication.release_notes: First release: create, edit and publish websites, and check build status.

sq-AL.subtitle: Ndërtues faqesh në shqip
sq-AL.description: Ndërto një faqe në shqip vetëm duke e përshkruar. Trego për biznesin tënd dhe Mjegulla krijon faqet, tekstet dhe imazhet në llogarinë tënde dhe të jep një adresë publike. Kërko ndryshime me fjalë të thjeshta dhe publiko versionin e fundit kur të jesh gati.

de-DE.subtitle: Albanischer Website-Builder
de-DE.description: Erstelle eine Website auf Albanisch, indem du sie einfach beschreibst. Mjegulla erstellt Seiten, Texte und Bilder in deinem Konto und gibt dir eine öffentliche Adresse. Wünsche Änderungen in einfachen Worten und veröffentliche die neueste Version.

fr-FR.subtitle: Créateur de sites en albanais
fr-FR.description: Créez un site en albanais simplement en le décrivant. Mjegulla crée les pages, les textes et les images dans votre compte, avec une adresse publique à partager. Demandez des modifications en langage courant et publiez la dernière version.
